2670ae0e44b3c5332dd99fa4713d822af9354126.summary: Group-IB report on BlackCat (also ALPHV), a Rust-based ransomware-as-a-service group active from late 2021. It describes double and triple extortion, affiliate access via stolen credentials and ProxyShell flaws, and tools including Cobalt Strike, Impacket, PsExec and Rclone. Notable cases include Change Healthcare (February 2024, $22 million ransom paid), MGM Resorts and Caesars (September 2023), and Reddit (February 2023). The report says the group shut down in March 2024 in what it describes as an exit scam, and that Cicada3301 may be a rebrand.

hedges: Analysts suspect Cicada3301 is BlackCat 2.0 operating under a new name, according to the report.
The report says it is difficult to say for sure whether Cicada3301 fully adopted the BlackCat codebase; partial reuse seems more plausible.
Group-IB investigators find the overlap of two major ransomware groups in one incident to be unusual and possibly coincidental.
The report estimates the overall number of BlackCat victims since December 2021 is about 140.
The report says hackers were believed to be the same BlackCat/Scattered Spider team that hit Caesars Entertainment.
The report says BlackCat pretended the FBI seized its site as cover for an exit scam; the catalyst appears to have been greed.
The report says law enforcement actions may have contributed to pressure on the group.
The report says MGM refusing to pay likely contributed to the prolonged outage.
